achievements.name: Living Legend
achievements.description: Obtain all base game achievements.

achievements.name: Gathering Storm
achievements.description: Recover the katana of Clan Sakai (in the prologue, after choosing your horse).

achievements.name: Point of No Return
achievements.description: Complete the Act 1 tale 'The Warrior's Code'.

achievements.name: Company of Wolves
achievements.description: Complete the Act 1 tale 'The Tale of Ryuzo'.

achievements.name: Stoking the Flame
achievements.description: Complete the Act 1 tale 'The Broken Blacksmith'.

achievements.name: Family Reunion
achievements.description: Complete the Act 1 tale 'Shadow of the Samurai'.

achievements.name: Leader of the People
achievements.description: Complete the Act 2 tale 'The Ghost of Yarikawa'.

achievements.name: Birthright
achievements.description: Complete the Act 2 tale 'Ghosts from the Past'.

achievements.name: Dying Embers
achievements.description: Complete the Act 2 tale 'A Reckoning in Blood'.

achievements.name: The Ghost
achievements.description: Complete the Act 2 tale 'From the Darkness'.

achievements.name: The Exiled Alliance
achievements.description: Complete the Act 3 tale 'Wolves at the Gates'.

achievements.name: Sovereign End
achievements.description: Complete the Act 3 tale 'Eternal Blue Sky'.

achievements.name: Mono No Aware
achievements.description: Finish the story (complete 'The Tale of Lord Shimura').

achievements.name: The Warrior Monk
achievements.description: Unlocks while completing all Tales of Tsushima (Norio's tale line).

achievements.name: The Vengeful Warrior
achievements.description: Unlocks while completing all Tales of Tsushima (Lady Masako's tale line).

achievements.name: The Unbending Archer
achievements.description: Unlocks while completing all Tales of Tsushima (Sensei Ishikawa's tale line).

achievements.name: The Headstrong Thief
achievements.description: Unlocks while completing all Tales of Tsushima (Yuna's tale line).

achievements.name: Teller of Tales
achievements.description: Complete all of the Mythic Tales.

achievements.name: Helping Sword Hand
achievements.description: Complete all Tales of Tsushima.

achievements.name: Flash of Steel
achievements.description: Defeat 20 enemies with a counterattack after a Perfect Parry.

achievements.name: Witness Protection
achievements.description: Shoot a terrified, fleeing enemy with an arrow.

achievements.name: All in the Wrist
achievements.description: Defeat the maximum amount of enemies within a single Standoff.

achievements.name: Open for Business
achievements.description: Successfully Stagger enemies 50 times.

achievements.name: There Can Be Only One
achievements.description: Successfully complete every duel.

achievements.name: Have a Nice Fall
achievements.description: Kill an enemy by knocking them off a ledge with a Shoulder Charge or Typhoon Kick.

achievements.name: Haunting Precision
achievements.description: Kill 20 enemies with Ghost Stance strikes.

achievements.name: The Ghost of Legend
achievements.description: Build your Legend to earn the title Ghost of Tsushima.

achievements.name: Quick Study
achievements.description: Learn the Stone, Water, Wind, and Moon combat stances.

achievements.name: Every Trick in the Book
achievements.description: Acquire all the throwable Ghost Weapon techniques.

achievements.name: The Perfect Storm
achievements.description: Fully upgrade your sword.

achievements.name: A Charming Man
achievements.description: Equip a charm in all 6 slots.

achievements.name: Gifted
achievements.description: Collect 10 gifts.

achievements.name: Slay
achievements.description: Acquire 30 pieces of Vanity Gear.

achievements.name: Light the Way
achievements.description: Rekindle all the lighthouses of Tsushima.

achievements.name: Den of Thieves
achievements.description: Unlocks in Act 2 on starting the tale 'A Message in Fire'.

achievements.name: Favor of the Kami
achievements.description: Find and honor all of the Shinto Shrines on Tsushima.

achievements.name: Honor the Unseen
achievements.description: Bow at 10 hidden altars across Tsushima.

achievements.name: Lost and Found
achievements.description: Find a Pillar of Honor and collect its sword kit.

achievements.name: Monochrome Masters
achievements.description: Buy an item from the Black or White Dye Merchant.

achievements.name: Cooper Clan Cosplayer
achievements.description: Acquire the Legendary Thief outfit (a Sly Cooper reference).

achievements.name: Dirge of the Fallen Forge
achievements.description: Play 'Lament of the Storm' on the flute at Taka's grave (after collecting five singing crickets).

achievements.name: A Moment in Time
achievements.description: Personalize a scene in Photo Mode.

achievements.name: Avid Reader
achievements.description: Collect 20 Records.

achievements.name: Know Your Enemy
achievements.description: Collect 20 Mongol artifacts.

achievements.name: Body, Mind, and Spirit
achievements.description: Complete all Hot Springs, Haiku, Inari Shrines, and Bamboo Strikes.

achievements.name: Hero of the People
achievements.description: Liberate 12 occupied areas in Izuhara.

achievements.name: A Fight For The Isle….
achievements.description: Liberate all occupied areas in Izuhara.

achievements.name: Good Riddance
achievements.description: Liberate 8 occupied areas in Toyotama.

achievements.name: Securing Sanctuary….
achievements.description: Liberate all occupied areas in Toyotama.

achievements.name: Mass Eviction
achievements.description: Liberate 7 occupied areas in Kamiagata.

achievements.name: A New Safe Haven
achievements.description: Liberate all occupied areas in Kamiagata.

achievements.name: Master Liberator
achievements.description: Liberate the entirety of Tsushima Island.

achievements.name: Transcendence
achievements.description: Complete all 3 Raid chapters.

achievements.name: Ultimate Warrior
achievements.description: Reach rank 20 with all roles.

achievements.name: Ultimate Truth
achievements.description: Complete the final wave in a gold Survival.

achievements.name: Promising Start
achievements.description: Complete a Legends Mode story.

achievements.name: True Understanding
achievements.description: Complete all Legends Mode stories on a single difficulty.

achievements.name: Self-Actualized
achievements.description: Reach rank 20 in any role.

achievements.name: Grand Opening
achievements.description: Purchase something from Baku the Voiceless in New Game+.

achievements.name: A Legend for All Time
achievements.description: Complete Jin's Journey in New Game+.

achievements.name: Out of the Past
achievements.description: (Iki Island) Survive the Eagle's medicine and bid farewell to a new friend.

achievements.name: Friend to All Raiders
achievements.description: Complete all Tales of Iki.

achievements.name: The Benefit of All Beings
achievements.description: Build your Legend on Iki Island to earn the title Legacy Redeemer.

achievements.name: The Butcher Redeemed
achievements.description: Liberate Iki Island by defeating the Eagle and driving the invaders from Mongol territory.

achievements.name: Treasures of the Past
achievements.description: (Iki Island) Complete all Mythic Tales on Iki Island.

achievements.name: Elegy for Kazumasa
achievements.description: (Iki Island) Experience all five Memories of Your Father.

achievements.name: Common Courtesy
achievements.description: Discover and complete all unwritten tales on Iki Island.

achievements.name: Monkey See
achievements.description: (Iki Island) Interact with the three hidden Monkey Statues at Saruiwa.

achievements.name: Pride of Ishikawa
achievements.description: (Iki Island) Achieve bronze or higher on all Archery Challenges.

achievements.name: Chiyoko's Song
achievements.description: (Iki Island) Complete all Animal Sanctuaries.

achievements.name: A Few Splinters
achievements.description: Complete all bokken duels at the Hidden Cove Tournament.

achievements.name: Well-Rounded Warrior
achievements.description: Complete all Haiku, Onsen, Shinto Shrines, and Bamboo Strikes on Iki Island.

achievements.name: Blood on Your Hands
achievements.description: (Iki Island) Buy an item from the Crimson Dye Merchant.

achievements.name: Honor Bound
achievements.description: Bind a piece of gear to a class.

achievements.name: Champion of the Kami
achievements.description: Win a Legends Rivals match.

achievements.name: Cursed No More
achievements.description: Purify a Cursed piece of gear.

achievements.name: A Painful Blockage
achievements.description: Summon five Shades in a single Rivals match.
